bio.text: Chip Roy represents Texas's 21st Congressional District, which includes South Austin, North San Antonio and the Texas Hill Country.

Before Congress he was First Assistant Attorney General of Texas, chief of staff to Sen. Ted Cruz, a senior advisor to Gov. Rick Perry, a Senate Judiciary Committee staff director under Sen. John Cornyn, and a federal prosecutor.
He holds a B.S. and M.A. from the University of Virginia and a J.D. from the University of Texas.
